units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 26:5">Kel. XXVI, 5</cite> <he>עור הכ׳</he> the hide which the porter uses to protect his clothes. Y. Kidd. II, beg. 62ᵃ <he>ע״ר הכ׳</he> on the testimony of the carrier (that delivered the goods); a. e.—Pl. <he>כַּתָּפִים</he>, <he>כַּתָּפִין</he>. Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᵇ bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:1:11">Y. Ber. III, 6ᵃ</cite> top <he>נמסר לכ׳</he> when the corpse has been given over to the pall-bearers. Y. Shebi. VIII, 38ᵇ [read:] <he>החמרין הכ׳ וכל העושין בשביעית שכרן וכ׳</he> the drivers and porters and all employees in the Sabbatical year take their wages in fruits of that year (v.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 6:26">Tosef. ib. VI, 26</cite>); a. e.—<he>שבח המגיע לכ׳</he> an improvement touching the carriers, i.e. an increase of the value of the crop, opp. to an increase of the value of the land.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 95b">B. Kam. 95ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 15b">B. Mets. 15ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
